description: Declared mutants of the SDL line (docs/architecture/target/v2/sdl-declaration.zh-Hant.md; Design Invariants in docs/architecture/target/v2/sdl.zh-Hant.md). Sub-batch P (v8-arch-gyo2-sdl-p): only selected Plugins are added. The plugins/ roots of the OS guards are in docs/architecture/plans/os-subsystem/scripts/mutations.json (sdlp-*). A mutant is killed only when its check fails with the expected message. Run with tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --build-dir <a test build> --catalog docs/architecture/target/v2/scripts/sdl_mutations.json.
